Hi! I'm Aziz 👋 Digital Marketer, turning ad budgets into profit, helping businesses scale through systemic digital marketing for the last 7 years,
specializing in creating sales funnels and marketing automation.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: Certified Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, and Yandex Direct specialist. Constantly learning new tools and approaches in digital marketing to achieve maximum ad campaign efficiency.

Abris Distribution.achievements: Successful launch of a digital project to promote EV charging stations in the UAE from scratch: landing page development, end-to-end analytics setup, marketing automation, and ad campaign launch.;Achievements: stable lead generation at $10 per lead via Meta and Google Ads campaigns upon entering a new market.

Cheil Kazakhstan.achievements: Development and implementation of customer journey for Samsung users with trigger email newsletters, push notifications, and targeted campaigns based on owned channels.;Achievements: annual revenue through owned channels and direct marketing reached $5.9M, successful integration and work with data in the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem (Analytics, Audience Manager, Campaign Classic).;Management of advertising campaigns for the leading automotive holding Astana Motors, including premium and mass brands (Hyundai, BMW, Toyota, Lexus, Land Rover, Jaguar, Volvo, and others) in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Yandex Direct.;Achievements: optimization of advertising campaigns with a total budget of over 40 million tenge per month, setup of end-to-end analytics for 12+ brands, which led to a 35% reduction in the cost of a test drive request while maintaining lead quality.

Analytics.description: Deep experience with GA4, Yandex Metrica, Facebook Pixel. Setup of end-to-end analytics and automated reporting systems.

Ads Platforms.description: Professional management of advertising campaigns in Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads focused on ROI and conversion.

Media Planning.description: Comprehensive analysis and optimization of advertising channels to maximize marketing campaign efficiency and achieve business goals.

CRM Integration.description: Professional integration and setup of CRM systems (AmoCRM, Bitrix24) to create a unified information space: business process automation, sales funnel management, end-to-end analytics, and multi-channel communication with clients in one interface.

Tilda.description: Creation of attractive, high-conversion landing pages

Canva.description: Tool for creating professional visual creatives - from static images and infographics to animated videos and presentations, ensuring maximum audience engagement through bright and effective visual content.
